stories.headline: Harry Kane wins the Ballon d'Or
stories.summary: Football's Ballon d'Or was handed out at the London Palladium on 26 October, the first time the ceremony has been organised outside France or Switzerland. The Bayern Munich forward Harry Kane won the men's award for the first time, and was the first English player to take it since Michael Owen in 2001. Alexia Putellas won the women's award for the third time in her career, equalling the record of Aitana Bonmatí.

stories.headline: Dictionary.com picks maxxing as its word of the year
stories.summary: Dictionary.com has named maxxing its word of the year for 2026, after a surge in its use across social media. The suffix -maxxing is internet slang for maximising a particular quality or activity. The site makes its choice from search trends across the year and the news events that drive them.

stories.headline: Spiders sleep in stages, one of them dream-like
stories.summary: Researchers at the University of Bonn have found that spiders sleep in distinct stages, including one that resembles the REM sleep of people. They studied the Australian jumping spider Portia fimbriata, which hunts other spiders rather than insects. A fully grown adult is only about the size of a one-euro coin.
